The '''Activation Primer''' was a component used on [[diamond boron missile]]s. The Primer was located at the base of the tip of the [[Missile/Legends|missile]], behind the [[Targeting computer/Legends|tracking computer]] but forward of the [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]] [[Boron/Legends|boron]] plating.<ref name="EGWT" />
